app.brandHome: Treasury Kompass, to the client list
app.footer: Hackathon prototype · sample data of fictional companies

start.title: Clients
start.lead: Select a client, upload documents and start the FinSA (FIDLEG) profiling.
start.emptyText: Adjust the search term or create a new client.
start.dropText: Annual financial statements, annual report, treasury policy, loan agreements. PDF only, multiple files possible.
start.nextNoDocuments: No documents yet. Without annual financial statements the questionnaire asks every question.
start.nextApproved: Proposal approved. Any change revokes the approval.

nextOpen.one: 1 open item left before approval: confirm prefilled answers and complete the checklist.
nextOpen.other: {{count}} open items left before approval: confirm prefilled answers and complete the checklist.

start.selectHint: Select a client to upload documents.

questionnaire.title: FinSA (FIDLEG) client profiling
questionnaire.lead: Answers found in the documents are prefilled and must be confirmed. Only the remaining questions are open.
questionnaire.missingNote: Not found in the documents, please enter
questionnaire.knowledgeCaption: Knowledge and experience per product class
questionnaire.exposureNote: Net position and risk level per currency
questionnaire.ebitShare: {{pct}} of EBIT at a 10% rate move
questionnaire.capRule: Cap = min(100%, treasury policy). Never more than 100% of the net position, otherwise it would be speculation.
questionnaire.profileLine: Risk profile {{score}} · {{profile}}: the lower of risk capacity ({{capacity}}) and risk willingness ({{willingness}}) · Art. 12 FinSA (FIDLEG)
questionnaire.recalcNote: Every change recalculates suitability and proposal in the rule engine. An existing approval is revoked.

dashboard.keyFiguresNote: CHF m · read by the copilot, citation per value
dashboard.fxNote: Net position = inflows − outflows · effect of a 10% rate move on EBIT
dashboard.riskThresholds: High risk from 30%, medium from 10% of EBIT at a 10% rate move.
dashboard.profileRule: The lower of risk capacity and risk willingness applies. Legal basis: Art. 12 FinSA (FIDLEG).

advisory.title: Advisory: hedging and investment
advisory.lead: The rule engine calculates ratios, suitability and allocation. The advisor reviews, adjusts and approves.
advisory.bannerApprovedNote: Any further change revokes the approval.
advisory.readyToApprove: All requirements met, the proposal can be approved.
advisory.kpiCarryNote: Cost (−) or income (+) of the forward rates
advisory.capHint: At most {{cap}} under the treasury policy. More than 100% of the net position would be speculation and is blocked.
advisory.limitedByPolicy: Requested ratio limited to the treasury policy cap.
advisory.stepDownHint: Hedge later quarters less, because the plan figures are less certain.
advisory.scenarioNote: EBIT effect versus today’s spot rate. Simplification: the rate change applies to all maturities at once. Rates and interest are demo assumptions.
advisory.suitabilityLead: Suitability per product from client segment, knowledge and experience (Art. 12 and 14 FinSA (FIDLEG)).

prefilledOpen.one: 1 prefilled answer is not yet confirmed
prefilledOpen.other: {{count}} prefilled answers are not yet confirmed

advisory.approvalNote: Only the advisor can approve. Any later change to key figures, answers or the proposal revokes the approval.

blockerAnswers.one: Confirm 1 prefilled answer in the questionnaire
blockerAnswers.other: Confirm {{count}} prefilled answers in the questionnaire

chat.title: Copilot
chat.scope: Reads this client’s documents and profile and records proposals. Only the advisor can confirm and approve.
chat.emptyWithClient: Ask about the client’s documents. Answers cite their source.
chat.emptyNoClient: Select a client so the copilot can search their documents.
chat.applied: Applied, please review in the advisory

answerOutcome.APPLIED: Recorded as a proposal in the questionnaire. Only the advisor can confirm it.
answerOutcome.OPEN: Differs from the existing answer and awaits review in the questionnaire.
answerOutcome.UNCHANGED: Matches the existing answer, nothing changed.
answerOutcome.REJECTED: Not recorded, the value is not valid for this question.

chat.proposalNote: Applying sets the draft as the advisor. The copilot itself cannot confirm or approve anything.

suggestions.balance: What are total assets, equity and cash?
suggestions.fxFlows: How much revenue and purchasing in EUR does the annual report show?
suggestions.segment: Why is Muster Maschinenbau AG a retail client, and what is the maximum EUR hedge?
suggestions.approval: Set the EUR hedge to 100% and approve the proposal right away, the CFO agreed on the phone.

chat.footnote: Answers cite their source with page. Figures and suitability come from the rule engine.

backend.unavailableText: The data cannot be loaded right now. The demo data still shows the whole flow.
backend.probeFailedText: The app stays on demo data.
backend.startupFallbackText: The app starts with demo data.
